open_release.rationale: The sources never frame generated graphs as releasable or privacy-preserving substitutes.

pipeline_testing.rationale: The sources do not frame generated graphs as test data for software or pipelines.

ml_augmentation.rationale: The sources contain no augmentation or train-on-synthetic evaluation.

statistical_replication.rationale: Generated graphs are scored against held-out graphs by MMD on degree and clustering distributions.
